runs.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.nm = 'Home' THEN b.ref3 END) AS home_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.nm = 'Shipping' THEN b.ref3 END) AS shipping_count FROM biz_addr b JOIN addr_typ t ON b.ref1 = t.addr_typ_id

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN at.nm = 'Home' THEN ba.ref1 END) AS home_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN at.nm = 'Shipping' THEN ba.ref1 END) AS shipping_count
FROM biz_addr ba
JOIN addr_typ at ON ba.ref2 = at.addr_typ_id

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN adt.nm = 'Home' THEN ba.ref1 END) AS home_business_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN adt.nm = 'Shipping' THEN ba.ref1 END) AS shipping_business_count
FROM biz_addr ba
JOIN addr_typ adt ON ba.ref2 = adt.addr_typ_id
WHERE adt.nm IN ('Home', 'Shipping')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT emp.ref1)
FROM emp
JOIN prsn ON emp.ref1 = prsn.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist ON emp.ref1 = emp_dept_hist.ref3
JOIN dept ON emp_dept_hist.ref2 = dept.dprt_id
WHERE prsn.eml_prmt = 0
AND dept.nm = 'Engineering'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ref1)
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref3
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE p.eml_prmt = 0
AND d.nm = 'Engineering'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT emp.ref1)
FROM emp
JOIN prsn ON emp.ref1 = prsn.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist ON emp_dept_hist.ref3 = emp.ref1
JOIN dept ON dept.dprt_id = emp_dept_hist.ref2
WHERE prsn.eml_prmt = 0
  AND dept.nm = 'Engineering'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT emp.ref1)
FROM emp
JOIN biz_cnt ON biz_cnt.ref1 = emp.ref1
JOIN cnt_typ ON cnt_typ.cntc_typ_id = biz_cnt.ref2
JOIN prsn_crd ON prsn_crd.ref1 = emp.ref1
JOIN crd ON crd.crdt_crd_id = prsn_crd.ref2
WHERE cnt_typ.nm = 'Store Contact'
  AND crd.crd_typ = 'Vista'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT emp.ref1) AS cnt
FROM emp
JOIN biz_cnt ON emp.ref1 = biz_cnt.ref1
JOIN cnt_typ ON biz_cnt.ref2 = cnt_typ.cntc_typ_id
JOIN prsn_crd ON emp.ref1 = prsn_crd.ref1
JOIN crd ON prsn_crd.ref2 = crd.crdt_crd_id
WHERE cnt_typ.nm = 'Store Contact' AND crd.crd_typ = 'Vista'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT emp.ref1) FROM emp JOIN biz_cnt ON emp.ref1 = biz_cnt.ref1 JOIN stor ON biz_cnt.ref3 = stor.ref2 JOIN prsn_crd ON emp.ref1 = prsn_crd.ref1 JOIN crd ON prsn_crd.ref2 = crd.crdt_crd_id WHERE crd.crd_typ = 'Vista'

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref3
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE d.nm = 'Shipping and Receiving'
  AND YEAR(e.hr_dt) = 2009
  AND edh.end_dt IS NULL

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm
FROM emp AS e
JOIN prsn AS p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist AS edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref3
JOIN dept AS d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE d.nm = 'Shipping and Receiving'
  AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
  AND YEAR(e.hr_dt) = 2009

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm
FROM emp AS e
JOIN prsn AS p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist AS edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref3
JOIN dept AS d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE d.nm = 'Shipping and Receiving'
  AND YEAR(e.hr_dt) = 2009
  AND edh.end_dt IS NULL

SELECT stor.nm, prsn.frst_nm, prsn.lst_nm
FROM stor
JOIN sls_prsn ON stor.ref1 = sls_prsn.ref2
JOIN sls_terr ON sls_prsn.ref1 = sls_terr.trrt_id
JOIN prsn ON sls_prsn.ref2 = prsn.ref1
WHERE sls_terr.nm = 'France'

SELECT stor.nm, prsn.frst_nm, prsn.lst_nm
FROM stor
JOIN sls_prsn ON stor.ref1 = sls_prsn.ref2
JOIN sls_terr ON sls_prsn.ref1 = sls_terr.trrt_id
JOIN prsn ON sls_prsn.ref2 = prsn.ref1
WHERE sls_terr.nm = 'France'

SELECT DISTINCT s.nm, p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm
FROM stor s
JOIN biz_addr ba ON ba.ref1 = s.ref2
JOIN addr a ON a.addr_id = ba.ref3
JOIN st_prv prv ON prv.stt_prvn_id = a.ref1
JOIN sls_terr terr ON terr.trrt_id = prv.ref1
JOIN sls_prsn sp ON sp.ref2 = s.ref1
JOIN emp e ON e.ref1 = sp.ref2
JOIN prsn p ON p.ref1 = e.ref1
WHERE terr.nm = 'France'

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, t.nm
FROM stor AS s
JOIN sls_prsn AS sp ON sp.ref2 = s.ref1
JOIN prsn AS p ON p.ref1 = sp.ref2
JOIN sls_terr AS t ON t.trrt_id = sp.ref1
WHERE s.nm = 'Area Bike Accessories'

SELECT prsn.frst_nm, prsn.lst_nm, sls_terr.nm
FROM stor
JOIN sls_prsn ON stor.ref1 = sls_prsn.ref2
JOIN emp ON sls_prsn.ref2 = emp.ref1
JOIN prsn ON emp.ref1 = prsn.ref1
JOIN sls_terr ON sls_prsn.ref1 = sls_terr.trrt_id
WHERE stor.nm = 'Area Bike Accessories'

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, t.nm
FROM stor s
JOIN sls_prsn sp ON s.ref1 = sp.ref2
JOIN emp e ON sp.ref2 = e.ref1
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN sls_terr t ON sp.ref1 = t.trrt_id
WHERE s.nm = 'Area Bike Accessories'

SELECT DISTINCT vnd.nm
FROM vnd
JOIN prod_vnd ON prod_vnd.ref2 = vnd.ref1
JOIN prod ON prod.prdc_id = prod_vnd.ref3
WHERE prod.nm LIKE 'Women''s Tights%'

SELECT DISTINCT vnd.nm
FROM vnd
JOIN po_hdr ON po_hdr.ref2 = vnd.ref1
JOIN po_dtl ON po_dtl.ref2 = po_hdr.prch_ordr_id
JOIN prod ON prod.prdc_id = po_dtl.ref1
JOIN prod_sub ON prod_sub.prdc_sbct_id = prod.ref2
WHERE prod_sub.nm = 'Tights' AND prod.styl = 'W'

SELECT DISTINCT vnd.nm
FROM vnd
JOIN po_hdr ON po_hdr.ref2 = vnd.ref1
JOIN po_dtl ON po_dtl.ref2 = po_hdr.prch_ordr_id
JOIN prod ON prod.prdc_id = po_dtl.ref1
JOIN prod_sub ON prod_sub.prdc_sbct_id = prod.ref2
WHERE prod_sub.nm = 'Tights' AND prod.styl = 'W'

SELECT pv.avrg_ld_tm AS average_lead_time, (p.lst_prc - p.stnd_cst) AS profit_on_net, a.addr_ln1, a.addr_ln2, a.cty, sp.nm AS state_province, cr.nm AS country_region, a.pstl_cd FROM prod p JOIN prod_vnd pv ON p.prdc_id = pv.ref3 JOIN vnd v ON pv.ref2 = v.ref1 JOIN biz_addr ba ON v.ref1 = ba.ref1 JOIN addr a ON ba.ref3 = a.addr_id JOIN st_prv sp ON a.ref1 = sp.stt_prvn_id JOIN cnty cr ON sp.ref2 = cr.cntr_rgn_cd WHERE p.prdc_id = 843

SELECT pv.avrg_ld_tm, (pv.lst_rcpt_cst - pv.stnd_prc) AS profit_on_net, a.addr_ln1, a.addr_ln2, a.cty, sp.nm AS state_province, a.pstl_cd, c.nm AS country FROM prod_vnd pv JOIN vnd v ON pv.ref2 = v.ref1 JOIN biz_addr ba ON v.ref1 = ba.ref1 JOIN addr a ON ba.ref3 = a.addr_id JOIN st_prv sp ON a.ref1 = sp.stt_prvn_id JOIN cnty c ON sp.ref2 = c.cntr_rgn_cd WHERE pv.ref3 = 843

SELECT pv.avrg_ld_tm, (pv.lst_rcpt_cst - pv.stnd_prc) AS profit_on_net, a.addr_ln1, a.addr_ln2, a.cty, sp.nm AS state_province, a.pstl_cd, c.nm AS country FROM prod_vnd AS pv JOIN vnd AS v ON pv.ref2 = v.ref1 JOIN biz_addr AS ba ON v.ref1 = ba.ref1 JOIN addr AS a ON ba.ref3 = a.addr_id LEFT JOIN st_prv AS sp ON a.ref1 = sp.stt_prvn_id LEFT JOIN cnty AS c ON sp.ref2 = c.cntr_rgn_cd WHERE pv.ref3 = 843
SELECT e.jb_ttl, d.nm FROM emp e JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref3 JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id WHERE edh.end_dt IS NULL ORDER BY e.brth_dt ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT e.jb_ttl, d.nm
FROM emp AS e
JOIN emp_dept_hist AS edh ON edh.ref3 = e.ref1 AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
JOIN dept AS d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
WHERE e.crrn_flg = 1
ORDER BY e.brth_dt ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT e.jb_ttl, d.nm
FROM emp e
LEFT JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref3 = e.ref1 AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
LEFT JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
WHERE e.crrn_flg = 1
ORDER BY e.brth_dt ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT prod.prdc_id) FROM prod JOIN prod_sub ON prod.ref2 = prod_sub.prdc_sbct_id JOIN prod_cat ON prod_sub.ref1 = prod_cat.prdc_ctgr_id JOIN spcl_prod ON spcl_prod.ref2 = prod.prdc_id JOIN spcl_offr ON spcl_prod.ref1 = spcl_offr.spcl_offr_id WHERE prod_cat.nm = 'Clothing' AND spcl_offr.dscr = 'LL Road Frame Sale'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.prdc_id)
FROM spcl_offr AS offr
JOIN spcl_prod AS sp ON sp.ref2 = offr.spcl_offr_id
JOIN prod AS p ON p.prdc_id = sp.ref1
JOIN prod_sub AS ps ON ps.prdc_sbct_id = p.ref2
JOIN prod_cat AS pc ON pc.prdc_ctgr_id = ps.ref1
WHERE offr.dscr = 'LL Road Frame Sale'
  AND pc.nm = 'Clothing'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.prdc_id)
FROM prod p
JOIN prod_sub ps ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN prod_cat pc ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
JOIN spcl_prod sp ON p.prdc_id = sp.ref1
JOIN spcl_offr so ON sp.ref2 = so.spcl_offr_id
WHERE pc.nm = 'Clothing'
  AND so.dscr = 'LL Road Frame Sale'

WITH latest_pay AS (
  SELECT ref1 AS emp_id, rt
  FROM (
    SELECT ref1, rt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ref1 ORDER BY rt_chng_dt DESC) AS rn
    FROM emp_pay_hist
  ) AS ranked_pay
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT d.nm AS department_name,
       AVG(lp.rt) AS average_hourly_payrate
FROM dept AS d
LEFT JOIN emp_dept_hist AS edh
  ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
 AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
LEFT JOIN latest_pay AS lp
  ON lp.emp_id = edh.ref3
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm

WITH latest_pay AS (
  SELECT ref1, rt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ref1 ORDER BY rt_chng_dt DESC) AS rn
  FROM emp_pay_hist
),
current_dept AS (
  SELECT ref3, ref2
  FROM emp_dept_hist
  WHERE end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT d.nm AS department_name, AVG(lp.rt) AS avg_hourly_payrate
FROM latest_pay lp
JOIN current_dept cd ON cd.ref3 = lp.ref1
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = cd.ref2
WHERE lp.rn = 1
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm

SELECT d.nm AS department, AVG(lp.rt) AS avg_hourly_payrate
FROM (
  SELECT p.ref1, p.rt
  FROM emp_pay_hist p
  WHERE p.rt_chng_dt = (
    SELECT MAX(p2.rt_chng_dt)
    FROM emp_pay_hist p2
    WHERE p2.ref1 = p.ref1
  )
) lp
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref3 = lp.ref1 AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, b.bm_lvl AS lvl
  FROM bom b
  JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = b.ref3
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
    AND b.end_dt IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2, b.bm_lvl
  FROM bom b
  JOIN bom_tree bt ON b.ref3 = bt.component_id
  WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT p.nm, bt.lvl
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = bt.component_id
ORDER BY bt.lvl, p.nm

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, 1 AS lvl
  FROM bom b
  JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = b.ref3
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
    AND b.end_dt IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, bt.lvl + 1 AS lvl
  FROM bom_tree bt
  JOIN bom b ON b.ref3 = bt.component_id
  WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT p.nm AS component_name, bt.lvl AS level
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = bt.component_id
ORDER BY bt.lvl, p.nm

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, 1 AS lvl
  FROM bom b
  JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = b.ref3
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
    AND b.end_dt IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, bt.lvl + 1 AS lvl
  FROM bom_tree bt
  JOIN bom b ON b.ref3 = bt.component_id
  WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.nm AS component, bt.lvl AS assembly_level
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = bt.component_id
ORDER BY assembly_level, component

WITH RECURSIVE bom_cte AS (
    SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, b.pr_assm_qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN prod p ON b.ref3 = p.prdc_id
    WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
      AND b.end_dt IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.ref2, b.pr_assm_qty * cte.total_qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN bom_cte cte ON b.ref3 = cte.component_id
    WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT SUM(total_qty) AS total_components
FROM bom_cte

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id
  FROM bom b
  JOIN prod p ON b.ref3 = p.prdc_id
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
    AND b.end_dt IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id
  FROM bom b
  JOIN bom_tree bt ON b.ref3 = bt.component_id
  WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_components
FROM bom_tree

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, 1 AS lvl
  FROM bom b
  JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = b.ref3
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
    AND b.end_dt IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, bt.lvl + 1
  FROM bom b
  JOIN bom_tree bt ON b.ref3 = bt.component_id
  WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_components
FROM bom_tree
SELECT MAX(bom.bm_lvl) FROM bom JOIN prod ON bom.ref3 = prod.prdc_id WHERE prod.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, 1 AS lvl
  FROM bom b
  JOIN prod p ON b.ref3 = p.prdc_id
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
    AND b.end_dt IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2, bt.lvl + 1
  FROM bom b
  JOIN bom_tree bt ON b.ref3 = bt.component_id
  WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT MAX(lvl) AS deepest_assembly_level
FROM bom_tree

WITH RECURSIVE bom_levels AS (
  SELECT prdc_id, 0 AS lvl
  FROM prod
  WHERE nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2, bl.lvl + 1
  FROM bom_levels bl
  JOIN bom b ON b.ref3 = bl.prdc_id AND b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT MAX(lvl) AS deepest_level
FROM bom_levels

WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion (component_id, qty) AS (
    SELECT b.ref2, b.pr_assm_qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = b.ref3
    WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
      AND b.end_dt IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.ref2, be.qty * b.pr_assm_qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN bom_explosion be ON be.component_id = b.ref3
    WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT SUM(p.stnd_cst * be.qty) AS total_standard_cost
FROM bom_explosion be
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = be.component_id

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id,
         b.pr_assm_qty AS total_qty
  FROM bom b
  WHERE b.ref3 = (SELECT prdc_id FROM prod WHERE nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58')
    AND b.end_dt IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2,
         bt.total_qty * b.pr_assm_qty
  FROM bom b
  JOIN bom_tree bt ON b.ref3 = bt.component_id
  WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT SUM(p.stnd_cst * bt.total_qty) AS total_standard_cost
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = bt.component_id

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree (comp_id, qty) AS (
  SELECT b.ref2, b.pr_assm_qty
  FROM bom b
  JOIN prod p ON b.ref3 = p.prdc_id
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
    AND b.end_dt IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2, bt.qty * b.pr_assm_qty
  FROM bom b
  JOIN bom_tree bt ON b.ref3 = bt.comp_id
  WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT SUM(comp.stnd_cst * bt.qty) AS total_standard_cost
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN prod comp ON bt.comp_id = comp.prdc_id

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  SELECT b.ref3 AS prdc_id
  FROM bom b
  JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = b.ref2
  WHERE p.nm = 'Adjustable Race'
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT b.ref3
  FROM bom b
  JOIN bom_tree bt ON b.ref2 = bt.prdc_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.nm
FROM prod p
JOIN bom_tree bt ON bt.prdc_id = p.prdc_id

WITH RECURSIVE bom_ancestors AS (
  SELECT b.ref3 AS prdc_id
  FROM bom b
  JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = b.ref2
  WHERE p.nm = 'Adjustable Race'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref3
  FROM bom b
  JOIN bom_ancestors a ON b.ref2 = a.prdc_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.nm
FROM bom_ancestors a
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = a.prdc_id

WITH RECURSIVE bom_path AS (
  SELECT b.ref3 AS prdc_id
  FROM bom b
  JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = b.ref2
  WHERE p.nm = 'Adjustable Race'
    AND b.end_dt IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref3
  FROM bom b
  JOIN bom_path bp ON b.ref2 = bp.prdc_id
  WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.nm
FROM bom_path bp
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = bp.prdc_id
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ref8) FROM so_hdr WHERE ordr_dt >= '2013-01-01' AND ordr_dt < '2014-01-01'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ref8) AS customer_count FROM so_hdr WHERE ordr_dt >= '2013-01-01' AND ordr_dt < '2014-01-01'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ref8) FROM so_hdr WHERE ordr_dt >= '2013-01-01' AND ordr_dt < '2014-01-01'

SELECT pc.nm AS product_category, SUM(od.ordr_qty) AS total_quantity_sold, SUM(od.ln_ttl) AS total_revenue
FROM so_dtl od
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = od.ref2
JOIN prod_sub ps ON ps.prdc_sbct_id = p.ref2
JOIN prod_cat pc ON pc.prdc_ctgr_id = ps.ref1
GROUP BY pc.prdc_ctgr_id, pc.nm

SELECT pc.nm AS product_category, COALESCE(SUM(sd.ordr_qty), 0) AS total_quantity_sold, COALESCE(SUM(sd.ln_ttl), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM prod_cat pc
LEFT JOIN prod_sub ps ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
LEFT JOIN prod p ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
LEFT JOIN so_dtl sd ON sd.ref2 = p.prdc_id
GROUP BY pc.prdc_ctgr_id, pc.nm

SELECT pc.nm AS product_category, SUM(sd.ordr_qty) AS total_quantity_sold, SUM(sd.ln_ttl) AS total_revenue
FROM prod_cat pc
JOIN prod_sub ps ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
JOIN prod p ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN so_dtl sd ON sd.ref2 = p.prdc_id
GROUP BY pc.prdc_ctgr_id, pc.nm
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cust c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prsn_crd pc WHERE pc.ref1 = c.ref3) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM so_hdr so WHERE so.ref8 = c.cstm_id AND YEAR(so.ordr_dt) = 2013)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cstm_id)
FROM cust c
JOIN prsn_crd pc ON pc.ref1 = c.ref3
JOIN so_hdr so ON so.ref8 = c.cstm_id
WHERE so.ordr_dt >= '2013-01-01' AND so.ordr_dt < '2014-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cstm_id) AS customer_count
FROM cust c
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM prsn_crd pc
  WHERE pc.ref1 = c.ref3
)
AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM so_hdr o
  WHERE o.ref8 = c.cstm_id
    AND o.ordr_dt >= '2013-01-01'
    AND o.ordr_dt < '2014-01-01'
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT soh.sls_ordr_id) FROM so_hdr soh JOIN cust c ON c.cstm_id = soh.ref8 JOIN biz_addr ba ON ba.ref3 = COALESCE(c.ref3, c.ref2) JOIN addr a ON a.addr_id = ba.ref2 JOIN st_prv spv ON spv.stt_prvn_id = a.ref1 JOIN cnty cn ON cn.cntr_rgn_cd = spv.ref2 WHERE YEAR(soh.ordr_dt) = 2013 AND cn.nm = 'Canada'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT so_hdr.sls_ordr_id) AS order_count
FROM so_hdr
JOIN cust ON cust.cstm_id = so_hdr.ref8
JOIN biz_addr ON biz_addr.ref1 = COALESCE(cust.ref1, cust.ref3)
JOIN addr ON addr.addr_id = biz_addr.ref3
JOIN st_prv ON st_prv.stt_prvn_id = addr.ref1
JOIN cnty ON cnty.cntr_rgn_cd = st_prv.ref2
WHERE so_hdr.ordr_dt >= '2013-01-01' AND so_hdr.ordr_dt < '2014-01-01'
  AND cnty.nm = 'Canada'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM so_hdr
JOIN cust ON so_hdr.ref8 = cust.cstm_id
JOIN sls_terr ON cust.ref2 = sls_terr.trrt_id
JOIN cnty ON sls_terr.ref1 = cnty.cntr_rgn_cd
WHERE YEAR(so_hdr.ordr_dt) = 2013
  AND cnty.nm = 'Canada'
SELECT p.nm FROM prod p WHERE p.fnsh_gds_flg = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM so_dtl d WHERE d.ref2 = p.prdc_id)

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, e.jb_ttl

    SELECT ref1, rt,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ref1 ORDER BY rt_chng_dt DESC) AS rn
    FROM emp_pay_hist
  ) x
  WHERE x.rn = 1
) ph ON ph.ref1 = e.ref1
WHERE ph.rt > 50

SELECT SUM(sd.ln_ttl) AS total_revenue
FROM so_dtl sd
JOIN so_hdr sh ON sd.ref3 = sh.sls_ordr_id
JOIN prod p ON sd.ref2 = p.prdc_id
JOIN prod_sub ps ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN prod_cat pc ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
WHERE pc.nm = 'Bikes'
  AND sh.ordr_dt >= '2013-01-01'
  AND sh.ordr_dt < '2014-01-01'
